title: WeaponsConfig
description: The weapon profiles, content/weapons.yaml (CONFIG-AND-CONTENT §7.2). NX-367 ships id and targets only (Q-CFG-10); range, Pk, damage, ammo and bands join with the combat items.

targets.description: What the weapon may fire on (COMBAT §5.1, CB-1, CB-10); no duplicates (loader). STRUCTURE = node defenses and bridges. SEA arrives with naval units (P3).
